title: Ep 42 — The Ghostwriter Behind Fifteen Thousand Books, and a Fundraising Regulator Promise That Slipped to Next Year
description: A quiet day for AI releases makes room for a deep dive on AIWriteBook, the solo-founder tool that has helped over fifteen thousand authors self-publish, niched here into a grassroots-club history-book fundraiser for PlayFundWin. Plus the Fundraising Regulator quietly pushes its free-draw registration timeline from September to early twenty twenty-seven, and a quiet week for both LeaguePages sector news and EV charging at sports venues.
